```{python}
#| label: fig-ate
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Structure of a mixed-signal automatic test equipment (ATE): the workstation controls the mainframe (power supplies, instruments, tester computer with DSP), which connects to the test head carrying the sensitive measurement frontends and the device interface board (DIB) with the DUT socket; a handler feeds the devices."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle, FancyArrowPatch


def box(ax, x, y, w, h, text, fc='#e8eef4'):
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x, y), w, h, fc=fc, ec='k', lw=1.0))
    ax.text(x + w / 2, y + h / 2, text, ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=9)


def arrow(ax, x0, y0, x1, y1):
    ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch((x0, y0), (x1, y1), arrowstyle='<->',
                                 mutation_scale=12, lw=1.0))


fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 3.2))

box(ax, 0.2, 1.0, 2.4, 1.4, 'workstation\n(test engineer)')
box(ax, 3.4, 0.4, 3.0, 2.6, 'mainframe\n(supplies,\ninstruments,\ntester CPU + DSP)')
box(ax, 7.2, 1.0, 2.4, 1.4, 'test head')
box(ax, 10.4, 1.0, 2.2, 1.4, 'DIB + socket\n(DUT)', fc='#f4e8d8')
box(ax, 10.4, 3.0, 2.2, 1.0, 'handler', fc='#e8f4e8')

arrow(ax, 2.6, 1.7, 3.4, 1.7)
arrow(ax, 6.4, 1.7, 7.2, 1.7)
arrow(ax, 9.6, 1.7, 10.4, 1.7)
arrow(ax, 11.5, 3.0, 11.5, 2.4)

ax.set_xlim(0, 12.9)
ax.set_ylim(0, 4.3)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
